docket_entries.description: REMARK: RETURNED MAIL: SMALL CLAIMS CONTINUE ORDER MAILED TO DEFENDANT ON 10/29/19. PER U.S. POSTAL SERVICE, "RETURN TO SENDER - NOT DELIVERABLE AS ADDRESSED - UNABLE TO FORWARD."

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-27-2020 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO FEB-18-2020 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF PHILIP LAM IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISO IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY CHRISTINE ECHAVIA, CLAIMS INVESTIGATOR. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT PRIOR TO HEARING. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE FEB 18TH HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCE AT THE FEB 18TH HEARING THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A.
